006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Provides a common base class for string-based data types.
017 *
018 * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
019 *          the Metapath item type supported by the adapter
020 */
021public abstract class AbstractStringAdapter<ITEM_TYPE extends IStringItem>
022    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<String, ITEM_TYPE> {
023
024  /**
025   * Construct a new string-based adapter.
026   *
027   * @param itemClass
028   *          the Java type of the Matepath item this adapter supports
029   * @param castExecutor
030   *          the method to call to cast an item to an item based on this type
031   */
032  protected AbstractStringAdapter(
033      @NonNull Class<ITEM_TYPE> itemClass,
034      @NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM_TYPE> castExecutor) {
035    super(String.class, itemClass, castExecutor);
036  }
037
038  @Override
039  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
040    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public String parse(String value) {
045    return value;
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public String copy(Object obj) {
050    // a Java string is immutable
051    return (String) obj;
052  }
053}
